units.locator: Article 14. Structure of local self-government bodies
units.text: 3. The procedure for formation, powers, terms of office, reporting accountability and oversight of local self-government bodies are determined by the municipal charter in accordance with this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Structure of local self-government bodies
units.text: 4. In the cases provided for by this Federal Law, the procedure for formation, powers, terms of office, reporting accountability and oversight of local self-government bodies, as well as other matters concerning their organization and activities, are determined by the municipal charter in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, taking into account the requirements of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Structure of local self-government bodies
units.text: 5. The names of the representative body of a municipality, the head of a municipality and the local administration are established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, taking into account historical and other local traditions.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Structure of local self-government bodies
units.text: 6. State authorities and their officials may participate in the formation of local self-government bodies and in the appointment and removal of local self-government officials in the cases and in accordance with the procedure provided for by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Structure of local self-government bodies
units.text: 7. A decision of the representative body of a municipality to change the structure of local self-government bodies enters into force no earlier than the expiry of the term of office of the representative body that adopted the decision, except in the cases provided for by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Structure of local self-government bodies
units.text: 8. Where a newly formed municipality is created by transforming an existing municipality, the structure of its local self-government bodies is determined by the representative body of the municipality after its election and is set out in the municipal charter.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Structure of local self-government bodies
units.text: 9. The number of deputies in the first convocation of the representative body of a newly formed municipality and the procedure for electing its first head are established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, taking into account the provisions of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.text: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.label: Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.text: 1. The representative body of a municipality consists of deputies elected in municipal elections.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.text: 2. A newly elected representative body of a municipality convenes its first meeting within the period established by the municipal charter, which may not exceed 30 days from the date on which a legally competent composition of the representative body was elected.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.text: 3. A representative body of a municipality is considered to have been elected with a legally competent composition if at least two thirds of the established number of deputies have been elected.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.text: 4. The quorum for a meeting of the representative body of a municipality is determined by the municipal charter. A meeting of the representative body may not be considered quorate if fewer than 50 percent of the elected deputies are present.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.text: 5. Meetings of the representative body of a municipality are held at least once every three months.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.text: 6. The number of deputies in the representative body of an urban okrug or municipal okrug is determined by the municipal charter and may not be fewer than:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.text: 1) 7 deputies where the population is fewer than 1000 people;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.text: 2) 10 deputies where the population is from 1000 to 10 000 people;
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.text: 3) 15 deputies where the population is from 10 000 to 30 000 people;
units.label: Point 3 Part 6 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.text: 4) 20 deputies where the population is from 30 000 to 100 000 people;
units.label: Point 4 Part 6 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.text: 5) 25 deputies where the population is from 100 000 to 500 000 people;
units.label: Point 5 Part 6 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.text: 6) 35 deputies where the population exceeds 500 000 people.
units.label: Point 6 Part 6 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.text: 7. The representative body of an urban okrug or municipal okrug has the rights of a legal entity.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.text: 8. The activities of the representative body of a municipality are organized, in accordance with the municipal charter, by the chair of that representative body, elected by it from among its members.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.text: 9. Expenditure on supporting the activities of the representative body of a municipality is provided for in the local budget separately from other expenditure, in accordance with the expenditure classification of the budgets of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.text: 10. The representative body of a municipality or individual deputies (groups of deputies) may not, in any form, manage and/or dispose of local budget funds in the course of budget execution, except for local budget funds allocated to support the activities of the representative body and deputies.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Representative body of a municipality
units.text: 11. The settlement in which the representative body of a municipality is located, taking into account local traditions and the existing social infrastructure and in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, is the administrative center of that municipality.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.label: Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 1. The following fall within the exclusive competence of the representative body of a municipality:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 1) adoption of the municipal charter and amendments and additions to it;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 2) approval of the local budget and the report on its execution;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 3) establishment, introduction and termination of previously introduced local taxes and fees in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on taxes and fees;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 4) approval of the municipality’s socioeconomic development strategy;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 5) determination of the procedure for managing and disposing of municipally owned property;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 6) determination of the procedure for taking decisions on the establishment, reorganization and liquidation of municipal enterprises, and on setting tariffs for services provided and work performed by municipal enterprises and institutions, except in the cases provided for by federal laws;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 7) determination of the procedure for logistical and organizational support for the activities of local self-government bodies;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 8) oversight of the exercise by local self-government bodies and local self-government officials of powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 9) adoption of a decision to remove the head of the municipality from office in the cases provided for by this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 10) approval of rules for the improvement and upkeep of the municipality’s territory;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 11) hearing annual reports of the head of the municipality and the head of the local administration on the results of their activities, the activities of the local administration and other local self-government bodies subordinate to the head of the municipality, including the resolution of matters raised by the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 2. Other powers of municipal representative bodies are determined by federal laws and by constitutions (charters) and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and municipal charters adopted in accordance with them.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.label: Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 1. The powers of the representative body of a municipality terminate early in the following cases:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 1) entry into force of a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation on its dissolution;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 2) adoption by that body, in accordance with the procedure determined by the municipal charter, of a decision to dissolve itself;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 3) entry into force of a decision of the supreme court of the republic, the court of the krai or oblast, or the court of the city of federal significance, autonomous oblast or autonomous okrug, as applicable, finding that the current composition of deputies of the municipal representative body is not legally competent, including because deputies have resigned their mandates;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 4) transformation of the municipality in accordance with parts 6 and 7 of Article 12 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 5) an increase of more than 25 percent in the number of voters in the municipality;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 6) failure to meet the deadline for issuing a municipal legal act necessary to implement a decision adopted through the population’s direct expression of will.
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 2. If a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation dissolving the representative body of a municipality enters into force, its powers terminate early from the date on which that law enters into force.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 3. The highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation submits to the legislative body of that constituent entity a draft law on dissolution of the representative body of the municipality within three months after the entry into force of a court decision establishing:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 1) that the representative body of the municipality adopted a regulatory legal act conflicting with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws, the constitution (charter) or laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or the municipal charter, provided that the representative body failed, within three months after the court decision entered into force or within another period specified in the court decision, to take measures within its powers to implement the court decision, including repealing the relevant regulatory legal act;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 2) that the representative body of the municipality, elected with a legally competent composition, failed to hold a meeting for three consecutive months;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 3) that the newly elected representative body of the municipality, having a legally competent composition, failed to hold a meeting for three consecutive months from the date of its election.
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 4. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation dissolving the representative body of a municipality may be challenged in court within 10 days after its entry into force.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 5. Deputies of the representative body of a municipality dissolved on the grounds specified in points 2 and 3 of part 3 of this Article may, within 10 days after the entry into force of the law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation dissolving that body, apply to a court to establish that they were not at fault for the representative body’s failure to hold a quorate meeting for three consecutive months.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 6. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality entails early termination of the mandates of its deputies.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 7. If the powers of the representative body of a municipality terminate early, early elections to that representative body are held within the time limits established by federal law.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 18. Factions in the representative body of a municipality
units.text: Article 18. Factions in the representative body of a municipality
units.label: Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Factions in the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 1. Deputies of a municipal representative body elected as part of lists of candidates nominated by political parties (their regional branches or other structural subdivisions) belong to deputy associations (factions) (hereinafter, factions), except in the case provided for in part 3 of this Article. A faction includes all deputies (the deputy) elected as part of the relevant list of candidates. A faction may also include deputies elected in single-member or multi-member constituencies and deputies (a deputy) elected as part of a list of candidates of a political party (its regional branch or other structural subdivision) referred to in part 3 of this Article.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Factions in the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 2. The procedure governing the activities of factions is established by the rules of procedure or another act of the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Factions in the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 3. If a political party ceases to operate because of its liquidation or reorganization, the activities of its faction in the municipal representative body and the deputies’ membership in that faction cease on the date the corresponding entry is made in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Factions in the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 4. A deputy elected as part of a list of candidates nominated by a political party (its regional branch or other structural subdivision) may not leave the faction to which the deputy belongs under part 1 of this Article. Such a deputy may be a member only of the political party on whose list of candidates the deputy was elected.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Factions in the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 5. A deputy elected in a single-member or multi-member constituency who belongs to a faction, or a deputy elected as part of a list of candidates of a political party referred to in part 3 of this Article who belongs to a faction, may be a member only of the political party whose faction the deputy belongs to.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Factions in the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 6. A deputy elected as part of a list of candidates of a political party referred to in part 3 of this Article who joins a political party having a faction in the municipal representative body shall join that faction and may not leave it.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Factions in the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 7. Failure to comply with the requirements provided for in parts 4–6 of this Article entails early termination of the deputy’s mandate.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 18
